data.body:
An integration entry separates declared capability, recorded outcome and correspondence to current source. These answer different questions.

Passed describes the original recorded test scope. Matching requires the complete tested dependency closure to match the current build. Historical means participating bytes changed. Unknown means the closure or mapping is insufficient. A matching failure is still a failure.

The JSON Schema independent oracle retains individual failures. Protobuf source operations retain compiler versions and unsupported Editions. Five-priority binding evidence keeps ideal admission, qualified delivery and native equivalence distinct. A later timestamp does not erase an earlier contradictory result.

The evidence inventory includes unmapped records explicitly. This reference reads retained records; building the website does not rerun a native engine or renew qualification.

summary: An integration entry separates declared capability, recorded outcome and correspondence to current source. These answer different questions.
title: Read an integration result correctly
